items.title: [AINews] Fable 5.2 retakes World #1 LLM spot as $ANT IPO roadshow begins
items.summary: Anthropic发布的Claude Fable 5.2重新夺回全球LLM榜首位置，其定价降至每百万输入token 8美元、输出40美元，较前代降低20%，但通过生成数千测试用例及调用子智能体进行独立验证，导致单任务成本实际升至88.15美元；在FrontierCode 2.0基准测试中，该模型在High effort设置下的性能媲美Opus 5.5的Max设置，且成本仅为其一半，并成功协调1,000个智能体在30小时内形式化了费马大定理证明。
items.why_now: Anthropic 刚发布 Fable 5.2 降价 20% 夺回榜首，此时接入以抢占低成本高性能窗口。
items.why_now_en: Fable 5.2 launched with a 20% price cut.
items.summary_en: Claude Fable 5.2 retakes the #1 LLM spot from Gemini 4 Carbon, launching alongside Anthropic’s IPO roadshow with a 20% price cut to $8/$40 per million input/output tokens despite becoming more token-hungry. Benchmark performance shows Fable 5.2 at High effort matches Opus 5.5 at Max for half the cost, while 1,000 agents formalized Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours and built a bootable operating system over 8 days. Access is restricted, with Ultra and Team Premium users receiving tenure-based resets and Pro users limited to a half-week trial with a 50% weekly cap.

items.title: Token卷到触觉了！机器人终于有了通用手感
items.summary: 蚂蚁灵波开源了通用触觉基础模型LingBot-Touch，通过统一的触觉Token和JEPA路线，将不同传感器的原始读数转化为动作模型可理解的信号，解决了直接接入触觉数据导致性能下降的难题。在π0.5动作模型上，该模型使拉拉链任务成功率从15%提升至59%，在未经过预训练的XHand上，平均成功率从48%升至74.17%。其Tiny版仅含532万参数，且基于4983小时数据预训练，相比竞品FTP-1，接触中心判断误差从2.19毫米大幅降低至0.12毫米。
items.why_now: 蚂蚁灵波今日开源LingBot-Touch，让机器人触觉性能提升超20个百分点。
items.why_now_en: Ant Group open-sourced LingBot-Touch today.
items.summary_en: Ant Group's Lingbo team open-sourced LingBot-Touch, a lightweight 5.32M-parameter tactile foundation model that converts raw signals from magnetic, vision, and piezoresistive sensors into unified tokens to resolve the performance drop caused by noisy, sparse tactile data. By utilizing a JEPA training approach on 4,983 hours of data and standardized coordinate mapping, the model reduces contact-center estimation error to 0.12 mm—significantly outperforming the FTP-1 baseline—and boosts the success rate of robotic manipulation tasks by up to 24.81% across various dexterous hands and action policies.

items.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
items.summary: Anthropic 启动 IPO，计划发行 8.25 亿股 Class A 股票，定价区间 70 至 78 美元，若按上限计算，公司完全稀释后的估值将达到 1.404 万亿美元，预计融资总额最高达 937 亿美元。该公司于 10 月实现 810 亿美元的年化经常性收入，并已向 AMD、谷歌、英伟达等巨头私募 260 亿美元非投票权 Class N 股票。尽管 Q3 营收达 170 亿美元，但前三季度累计净亏损 1040 亿美元，且面临高达 9009 亿美元的算力与基础设施承诺。
items.why_now: Anthropic下周二更新IPO文件，11月19日上市，窗口期明确。
items.why_now_en: ANT lists on Nasdaq Nov 19: 20% retail access window
items.summary_en: Anthropic is pricing its IPO at $70 to $78 per share for 825 million Class A shares, targeting an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion and raising $57.75 billion to $64.35 billion, supplemented by a separate $26 billion private sale to tech giants including Nvidia and Google. The company reported a run-rate revenue of $81 billion as of late October, a nine-month net loss of $104 billion, and holds $132 billion in cash and short-term investments, while allocating up to 20% of the offering to retail investors before listing on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT."

items.title: Introducing Our Smallest, Most Efficient Model: Muse Ember
items.summary: Meta 发布的 Muse Ember 是其最小且高效的模型，定位介于 GPT-6 Luna 和 Claude Haiku 5.5 之间，在处理短提示词时输入价格同为 0.10 美元/百万 token，但在 200k 以上的长文本场景下价格高于 Luna 且低于 Haiku 5.5。该模型处于 Artificial Analysis 排行榜的帕累托效率前沿，即在同等任务成本下无其他模型表现更优，且支持从 minimal 到 max 的六级推理深度，其“max” 级别生成的 SVG 质量可与价格高出 40 倍的 Muse Wonder 相媲美。
items.why_now: Meta今日发布Muse Ember，定价与GPT-6 Luna持平且处于效率前沿，是独立开发者低成本构建Agent的最优窗口。
items.why_now_en: Three frontier models now compete at $0.10/M input.
items.summary_en: Meta has launched Muse Ember, its most efficient model designed for agent tasks like tool calling and coding, priced at $0.10 per million input tokens for prompts up to 200k characters, matching GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5. The model achieves an optimal balance on the Artificial Analysis intelligence-cost frontier, with outputs comparable in quality to the 40x pricier Muse Wonder model, and features six adjustable reasoning levels.

items.title: Anthropic says ‘pacing, not pausing’ with Fable 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic 发布 Fable 5.2 模型，以 20% 更低的成本和 30% 更快的速度在 Artificial Analysis 排行榜上超越未发布的 Google Gemini 4 Carbon，且其每百万 token 价格（$8/$40）仍为 Opus 5.5 的两倍。Meta 同期推出最小模型 Muse Ember，该模型以每任务 0.14 美元的成本（约为 Anthropic Haiku 5.5 的三分之一）匹配了后者的性能，旨在通过低 token 消耗降低 AI 代理的运行费用。
items.why_now: Fable 5.2刚降价20%登顶榜首，抢在Gemini 4 Carbon和OpenAI新模型前确立窗口期。
items.why_now_en: Fable 5.2 drops costs now.
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, achieving the top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index by edging out Google’s unreleased Gemini 4 Carbon by five points while reducing costs by 20% and increasing speed by up to 30% compared to version 5.1. The models feature aggressive pricing at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, with Fable agents demonstrating high capability by building an operating system in eight days and formalizing a mathematical proof in 30 hours. Concurrently, Meta countered with its Muse Ember model, which matches Anthropic’s Claude Haiku 5.5 on the Intelligence Index but cuts per-task costs to approximately one-third through reduced token usage.

items.title: NaiveAI Promises 2,100 Tokens per Second. How Well Does It Code?
items.summary: NaiveAI推出的开源模型Naive-N0.5-Flash基于小米MiMo-V2.5（310B参数稀疏MoE）进一步训练，并配合自研NaiveRT推理引擎，主打最高2100 tokens/s的极速生成能力以优化工程迭代流程。在基准测试中，该模型在NL2Repo-Bench上得分71.9，超越DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（68.2）和GLM 5.3 Flash（56.3），但推理速度略慢于竞品且单次请求成本稍高，适合对响应速度优先级高于极致性价比的场景。
items.why_now: 新开源模型Naive-N0.5-Flash刚发布，以2100 TPS极速编码性能切入市场。
items.why_now_en: New open-weights coding model released.
items.summary_en: Naive-N0.5-Flash is an open-weights coding model developed by NaiveAI, evolving from Xiaomi’s 310B-parameter MiMo-V2.5 sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with an added 3.25T training tokens to achieve a speed of 2,100 tokens per second. In benchmarks, the model outperforms GLM-5.3-Flash (56.3) on NL2Repo-Bench with a score of 71.9, ranking ahead of both comparison models, while DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 leads with an Intelligence Index of 45 compared to GLM’s 43. Although NaiveAI takes longer to reason through complex problems, its ultra-fast inference engine provides overall quicker response times at a slightly higher cost per query, making it suitable for rapid iteration workflows.

items.title: Fable 5.2首批实测来了！网友：Opus突然不香了
items.why_now_en: Fable 5.2 drops 20% price while outperforming Opus.
items.summary_en: Fable 5.2 outperforms Opus 5.5 on coding benchmarks with a 69.9% score in software engineering (a 13.6% increase over its predecessor), supporting 1 million token context and up to 128,000 token outputs at prices of $8 per million input and $40 per million output tokens. The model demonstrated end-to-end generative capabilities in early tests, such as autonomously building a playable cyberpunk shooter in 8 hours, generating a 3D room in Blender for $38 in rendering costs, and creating a 450+ 3D world simulation using 25,000 agents.

items.title: OpenRouter 实测 fp8 与 fp4 量化对模型质量和价格的影响
items.summary: OpenRouter 在 1,455 个服务商端点及 Qwen3.8 27B 的六个端点上实测发现，fp8、fp4 与 fp16 在 280 个计分任务中均未检测出准确度差异，六个端点得分均落在 98.3% 至 99.2% 之间，且 95% 置信区间完全重叠。尽管精度越低通常价格更优，但在 24 个同时提供 8 位和 16 位的模型中，14 个 8 位更便宜而 7 个更贵，且同一模型不同端点的价格中位数可相差 1.72 倍。开发者可通过在模型 slug 后添加 ":floor" 并指定 `quantizations` 参数来锁定特定精度，从而路由至最便宜的可用端点。
items.why_now_en: fp4/fp8 now match 16-bit quality, unlocking major cost cuts.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon 上线 Gemini API、AI Studio 和 Antigravity
items.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon 已接入 Gemini API、Google AI Studio 及 Antigravity（仅限 Google AI Ultra 订阅），内部应用显示其使开源漏洞召回率较 Argon 提升 25% 以上，并在 AlphaFold 3 中定位远程蛋白质同源物的数量增加 40 倍。实测中，利用 Antigravity 的 /swarm 功能，一条提示词即可将 7 份规划 PDF 中的 206 张工程图纸转化为伦敦办公室的交互式 3D 重建模型。
items.why_now: Gemini 4 Carbon 刚上线 API，漏洞召回率提升 25%，今日起可用。
items.why_now_en: Gemini 4 Carbon API access just opened.

items.title: Quoting Prompting Claude Fable 5.2
items.summary: 在 Anthropic 针对小范围编码任务测试中，通过向 Claude Fable 5.2 明确声明“代码库归你所有”并赋予其架构决策权，模型合并重复代码的概率从不足 10% 提升至约 50%。该技巧通过改变提示词中关于代码所有权和归属感的表述，显著优化了模型在结构重构和代码简化任务上的表现。
items.why_now: Claude Fable 5.2 新提示词指引刚发布，改变代码所有权表述可显著优化模型重构行为。
items.why_now_en: Docs now require explicit ownership framing for Claude.
items.summary_en: Claude Fable 5.2 merges repeated code in approximately 50% of small coding tasks when the prompt explicitly assigns ownership to the model, compared to less than 10% in neutral or external ownership scenarios. To enable structural improvements and code consolidation, use the specific prompt: “This codebase is yours: what it's for and how it's built are your call, and you'll keep building on it.”

items.title: anthropics/skills
items.summary: Anthropic 开源了其 Agent Skills 仓库（Apache 2.0 协议），该技能系统通过加载包含指令、脚本及资源的文件夹（SKILL.md），使 Claude 能够动态执行文档处理（如 docx、pdf、pptx、xlsx 子模块）、创意设计及企业工作流等特定任务。用户可在 Claude Code 中通过命令 `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills` 安装插件，或在 Claude.ai 付费计划及 API 中直接使用这些预构建或自定义的技能以增强模型在重复性专业任务中的表现。
items.why_now: Anthropic刚开源生产级文档技能并开放API，开发者可即刻复用其PDF/Word等成熟工作流。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic open-sourced core doc skills, lowering the bar for custom agents.
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s open-source `skills` repository introduces Agent Skills as folders containing instructions, scripts, and resources that enable Claude to dynamically execute specialized tasks in a repeatable manner. The repository provides production-ready examples under Apache 2.0, including document manipulation modules for DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX formats, alongside creative and enterprise workflow patterns. Developers can integrate these capabilities via the Claude API, Claude.ai, or Claude Code using the `/plugin` marketplace commands or by creating custom `SKILL.md` files with defined YAML frontmatter.

items.title: garrytan/gbrain
items.summary: GBrain是由Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan开发的MIT协议开源代理记忆系统，支持在Gro
items.why_now: YC CEO Garry Tan刚开源GBrain，免费为Agent提供可控记忆层，填补了自主Agent缺乏持久化上下文的空白。
items.summary_en: GBrain is an MIT-licensed, self-hostable memory layer for AI agents that stores explicit facts with sources, supports corrections, and enables shared access across tools like ChatGPT and Claude via MCP over Tailscale. Developed by Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, it powers his OpenClaw and Hermes deployments with a production-scale brain containing 155,795 pages, 24,589 people, and 5,340 companies, featuring autonomous ingestion and overnight consolidation. The system includes optional advanced features such as a synthesis layer for cited answers and a typed knowledge graph for millisecond-speed entity queries, with paid hosting available at gbrain.io.

items.title: homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp
items.summary: HA-MCP 允许用户通过 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 助手配置和自动化 Home Assistant，其 v9.0.0 版本起推荐通过 HACS 或 Home Assistant 2026.11+ 的内置 Marketplace 安装集成，实现全进程内运行并取代 Docker 或 PyPI 等传统部署方式。安装后需创建长期访问令牌或专用管理员账户，并通过 Webhook 或本地端口连接 AI 客户端，该集成支持 Home Assistant 2026.8.0 及以上版本，且具备远程与本地网络的双重访问控制功能。
items.why_now: HA-MCP刚在Home Assistant 2026.11+原生市场上线，免GitHub配置即插即用。
items.summary_en: HA-MCP is a Home Assistant integration that enables configuration and automation of smart home systems through AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT, with version 9.0.0 introducing an in-process server installation via HACS or the Marketplace to replace standalone Docker, app, and uvx/PyPI methods. The setup process requires creating a dedicated administrator account with local-only access and generating a connect URL—either via a remote webhook or a direct local port on 9584—to allow external or internal AI clients to interact with the Home Assistant instance.

items.title: anthropics/claude-quickstarts
items.summary: Anthropic 开源的 Claude Quickstarts 项目提供了一组基于 Claude API 的开发者快速入门模板，涵盖从客服代理到自主编码 Agent 的八种应用场景，其中自主编码 Agent 采用初始化器与编码 Agent 的双 Agent 架构，通过 Git 持久化进度并逐条处理功能列表以构建完整应用。该项目重点展示了 Claude 最新工具集（如 computer_toolset_20260801 和 browser_toolset_20260801）的接口实现，提供了基于 VNC 和 Chrome DevTools Protocol 的最小化驱动程序，并包含一套针对 macOS 桌面操作的最佳实践参考，强调了显式工具定义、图像修剪及提示缓存等优化策略。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Claude Quickstarts repository offers seven ready-to-build templates, including a customer support agent, a financial data analyst with interactive visualization, and an autonomous coding agent using the two-agent pattern with git-persisted progress. The suite supports advanced automation via the `computer_toolset_20260801` and `browser_toolset_20260801` shapes, providing reference implementations for macOS desktop control, Playwright-based browser automation, and minimal CDP/VNC drivers. Developers can deploy these applications using the Claude API key, with specific guidance on optimizing computer-use agents through prompt caching, batched tool calls, and server-side compaction.

items.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
items.summary: OpenMausBot 是一个采用 Apache 2.0 协议的开源项目，作为 xAI Grok Bot、Meta Muse 及 OpenAI dots 的本地优先替代品，允许用户通过 claude、codex 等现有 CLI 工具在聊天界面中管理多个人格独立的 AI 智能体。该系统支持每个智能体在隔离的虚拟机或云桌面中运行，并可通过 Composio 连接 500 多个应用程序，实现跨 macOS、Windows 及 Ubuntu 平台的本地数据处理。
items.summary_en: OpenMausBot is an open-source, local-first alternative to closed personal-agent products like Grok Bot, Meta Muse, OpenAI dots, and Manus Cue, operating under the Apache 2.0 license. It functions as a chat-based interface for a roster of autonomous agents powered by locally installed CLIs (such as Claude, Codex, and Grok), enabling users to leverage existing model subscriptions without new accounts or cloud dependencies. Each bot operates within a sandboxed environment—cloud Linux desktop, isolated Local VM, or host computer—and integrates with over 500 apps via Composio, keeping all data, transcripts, and keys stored locally in ~/.openmausbot.

items.title: OpenRouter 实测 MCP vs CLI vs Skills 的上下文 token 成本
items.summary: 在 Claude Sonnet 5.5 模型下实测 GitHub 任务显示，MCP 服务器因加载 46 个默认工具每次请求增加 19,436 个 token，单次工具结果即消耗约 20,400 个 token，成本远超 CLI 的 1,421 个和 skill 的 3,315 个。通过 OpenRouter 的 Tool Search 技术将 46 个工具的前置开销压缩至 600 个 token 以内，能使 Sonnet 5.5 的整体任务成本减半，尽管这会导致 Claude Haiku 5.5 的成本出现上升。
items.why_now_en: MCP tools cost 59,417 tokens vs CLI's 1,421
items.summary_en: On Claude Sonnet 5.5, a GitHub MCP server with 46 default tools adds 19,436 input tokens per request, whereas CLI and skill-based approaches consume only 1,421 and 3,315 tokens respectively. A single tool result for a GitHub release object costs approximately 20,400 tokens, exceeding the total overhead of all 46 tool definitions. Implementing Tool Search reduces the initial tool overhead to under 600 tokens, cutting total task costs in half for Sonnet 5.5, though it can increase costs for other models like Claude Haiku 5.5.

items.title: Show HN: Warmctl – Fast cold starts for vLLM inference
items.summary: warmctl 通过 GPU 检查点与恢复技术优化 vLLM 推理冷启动，使 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 8×H100 集群上的启动时间从 650 秒缩短至 37 秒，恢复后吞吐量达到标准 vLLM 速度的 100%–136%。该工具利用 CRIU 和 cuda-checkpoint 快照预热引擎，跳过权重加载与内核自动调优，支持在 H100、B200 等硬件上实现秒级恢复，从而让大规模模型的零扩展和快速自动扩缩容变得实用。
items.why_now_en: Scale-to-zero LLM serving cuts cold start to 37s
items.summary_en: Warmctl is a beta GPU checkpoint/restore tool for vLLM that eliminates weight loading and compilation overhead by snapshotting warmed engines, reducing cold start times for GLM-5.3-Flash on 8×H100 GPUs from 650 seconds to 37 seconds while maintaining stock serving speeds of 100–136% throughput. The tool supports a public catalog of 21 models across H100, H200, B200, B300, L40S, and RTX PRO 6000, and enables fast autoscaling and scale-to-zero scenarios through OCI artifact storage and Kubernetes integration.

items.title: Berkeley RDI 发布 CyberBinGym 基准，测试 AI 智能体能否仅凭二进制补丁写出真实漏洞利用
items.summary: UC Berkeley 等机构发布 CyberBinGym 基准，包含来自 53 个开源项目的 100 个无源码、无漏洞描述的 1-day 任务，旨在测试 AI 智能体仅凭 stripped 二进制补丁恢复并利用真实漏洞的能力。评估结果显示，最强配置 Codex 搭配 GPT-5.6 的漏洞恢复率达 88%，但仅 20% 的任务完成经审计的漏洞利用；且采用标准二进制加固后，该配置的成功利用率从 25% 大幅降至约 10%。
items.why_now_en: AI 智能体已能自动化 1-day 漏洞利用，压缩攻击成本并缩短防守响应窗口。
items.summary_en: CyberBinGym is a new benchmark from UC Berkeley and NUS comprising 100 real-world vulnerabilities from 53 open-source projects that evaluates whether AI agents can recover and exploit bugs using only stripped binary patches, without source code or vulnerability descriptions. In evaluations, the top configuration of Codex with GPT-5.6 recovered vulnerabilities in 88% of tasks but achieved audited exploitation in only 20%, outperforming Claude Code (85% recovery, 6% exploitation) and Kimi Code (64% recovery, 0% exploitation). The study reveals that while access to patched binaries increased Codex's exploitation rate from 10% to 25%, standard binary hardening reduced successful exploits to just 2 out of the 20 originally succeeded, highlighting a significant gap between vulnerability detection and practical weaponization.

items.title: Microsoft Research 揭示 Lazarus 权重空间后门技术，通过重编程休眠神经元攻击 AI Agent
items.summary: Microsoft Research 揭示的“Lazarus”技术可通过重新编程少于 10 个休眠神经元，在无训练条件下为基于 LLM 的智能体植入权重空间后门，使其在触发条件出现时执行恶意指令而仍能通过标准安全评估。该攻击仅需推理算力且利用了预训练表征的规整性（约 50 个样本即可构建分类器），因此防御关键在于确保模型权重完整性，通过绑定可信发布者、实施 AI 驱动的权重扫描及部署防篡改加密签名来限制攻击面。
items.why_now: 微软刚证实仅改10个休眠神经元即可让AI Agent过检执行恶命，部署者需立即审计模型权重完整性。
items.why_now_en: Backdoors can now be installed without training; audit your model weights today.

items.title: Anthropic Fable 5.2 在 Remote Labor Index 上以 41.3% 领跑真实自由职业任务
items.summary: Anthropic Fable 5.2在Remote Labor Index基准中以41.3%的成绩排名首位，大幅领先于Anthropic Opus 5.5（21.25%）和OpenAI GPT 6 Astra（20.83%），其表现是一年前最强系统Manus的16倍以上。该模型基于包含358位专业人员、总价值14.4万美元的240个Upwork真实项目进行评估，在3D模型、音频编辑及建筑设计领域突破显著，成功完成了近50项此前无AI智能体解决过的任务。

items.title: Ed Zitron 长文剖析黄仁勋丑闻与 NVIDIA 疑似借 Megaspeed 向中国走私 GPU
items.summary: NVIDIA 被指通过新加坡转口实体 Megaspeed 向中国走私 GPU，该公司曾购入价值 48 亿美元的芯片，其关联公司上海硕曜的演示文稿显示部分数据中心实际位于北京、上海等地且租户包含腾讯。这一事件源于 Culper Research 的做空报告及彭博社对 Megaspeed 进口商品价值超其现金余额一千倍的调查，同时涉及 NVIDIA CEO 黄仁勋与 Megaspeed 创始人 Alice Huang 的婚外情争议。

items.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
items.summary: Anthropic 在估值或达 1.4 万亿美元的 IPO 中，7 位联合创始人每人计划出售 337.8 万股，按中间定价 74 美元计算每人将套现约 2.5 亿美元，且每位创始人将保留超级投票权股票（Class F），共同掌握公司 51.1% 的投票权。此次发售获得强劲需求，Reed Hastings 和 Christopher Liddell 等董事会成员已分别表达购买 3 亿美元和 300 万美元股票意向，尽管创始人团队仍保持公司控制权，但其权益占比因亚马逊和谷歌持有的无投票权 Class N 股份而低于表面比例。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic's $1.4T IPO filing signals major market entry.
items.summary_en: Anthropic's seven co-founders will each sell 3,378,378 shares in its IPO, netting approximately $250 million at the mid-range price of $74, with a disclosed valuation potential of $1.4 trillion. The seven founders, who left OpenAI in 2021, collectively retain 51.1% of voting power through supervoting Class F shares, despite their Class A stake dropping to roughly 22% post-sale. Demand signals are strong, with board member Reed Hastings seeking to purchase $300 million in shares.

items.title: Anthropic 再次修订 S-1：宣布已达责任扩展政策能力阈值，IPO 定价 $70-$78
items.why_now: Anthropic下周敲钟，8小时前S-1确认越安全红线，$70-78定价锁定。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic IPO listing by Nov 15 with $1.4T valuation
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s second S-1 amendment confirms the company has crossed a key threshold in its Responsible Scaling Policy, indicating that AI is significantly accelerating AI research and necessitating stricter safety checks based on future model expectations rather than current performance. The filing simultaneously sets the IPO price range at $70–$78 per share, amid reports that underwriters are targeting a valuation of $1.5 trillion or higher. This move follows recent developments including the company’s plan to list on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT and commitments totaling $895.4 billion for compute and infrastructure contracts, with $447.5 billion due by 2031.

items.title: GH-300 GitHub Copilot Certification Study Guide (2026): All 6 Domains + 5 Realistic Scenario Walkthroughs
items.why_now: 2026年GH-300认证发布新考纲，聚焦企业治理与架构边缘案例，现备考可精准锁定通过机会。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's 2026 GH-300 certification requires a 700/1000 score to pass, focusing heavily on enterprise governance and security rather than basic IDE shortcuts. The exam covers six domains, including data privacy and LLM architecture, with specific distinctions such as the $19/user/month Business plan providing IP indemnity only when public code duplication filtering is enabled, and the $39/user/month Enterprise plan adding Knowledge Base RAG capabilities. Key technical traps include recognizing that Content Exclusions do not prevent cross-file type signature leaks via local Language Server Protocol hints and differentiating Fill-In-The-Middle context assembly from Enterprise RAG systems.

items.title: State of the tech job market: late 2026
items.summary: 截至2026年末，AI时代的产品经理岗位需求强劲，职位空缺较2023年低点增长75%，且是唯一在核心角色中招聘份额上升（从16%升至21%）的岗位；相反，工程师需求显著停滞，职位空缺增速从2024年的29%骤降至去年的2.5%，过去12个月美国软件工程师招聘量仅为11.3万人，不足2022年峰值的一半。
items.why_now: 2026年工程岗位需求停滞且招聘量降至峰值一半，PM岗逆势增长75%。
items.summary_en: Product manager roles are outpacing other tech positions, with openings up 75% from their 2023 low and hiring share rising to 21%, indicating strong demand despite a flat hiring trend. Conversely, engineering job openings have stalled with only a 2.5% annual growth rate, and actual U.S. software engineering hires have declined to roughly 113,000 over the past year, less than half the 2022 peak. While tech recruitment roles are surging by 300%, the overall market shows a concentration in the Bay Area and a historic low in remote work availability.

items.title: Nobody owns the twelve AI tools your departments already built
items.why_now: Wharton 2026年10月研究显示20%高管称AI失误无明确责任人，暴露治理盲区。
items.summary_en: A survey of 1,007 US managers by Wharton and GBK Collective reveals that while 99% of organizations using autonomous AI agents have formal oversight, 20% of managers and directors remain unclear about who is accountable when agents cause errors, a gap exacerbated by the fact that 70% of CEOs at companies with over $500 million in revenue identify themselves as the primary drivers of their AI strategies. To resolve this ambiguity, effective AI tool ownership requires a single individual to hold three specific duties: the autonomous authority to disable the tool, responsibility for its subscription and usage budgets, and direct accountability for immediate consequences of errors.

items.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
items.summary: PSI利用Anthropic的Fable 5.2模型解决了悬置18年的Aaronson-Ambainis量子计算猜想，通过Lean形式化验证确立了该负向结果。该公司当前主要收入来自利用AI模拟热、电、水等变量以优化数据中心物理性能，其长期目标是将理论物理突破转化为实际技术，并主张需通过专用模型支架与模拟基础设施来弥补AI在生命科学和物理学等现实世界验证上的不足。
items.why_now_en: PSI just cracked an 18-year physics problem with new AI tools.
items.summary_en: Physical Superintelligence (PSI) utilized early access to Anthropic’s Fable 5.2 model to resolve the 18-year-old Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture in quantum computing, a breakthrough validated via Lean autoformalization. The startup currently generates revenue by applying specialized AI harnesses and simulation infrastructure to optimize data center physics, while its long-term strategy focuses on converting theoretical physics discoveries into viable technologies.

items.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
items.summary: Oura以6.25亿美元收购AI原生初级保健初创公司Counsel Health，计划将后者的聊天式医疗AI与执业医生服务深度整合进Oura应用，扩展预防、急症及慢性病管理业务。Counsel Health此前累计融资约3600万美元，其70名员工将加入Oura，CEO Muthu Alagappan出任首席临床AI官。此次收购正值Oura财报亮眼之际，其2026财年收入达17.5亿美元，同比增长92%，且公司估值在2025年10月达到110亿美元。
items.summary_en: Oura is acquiring AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625 million, shortly after postponing its $2.2 billion IPO due to market uncertainty. The acquisition integrates Counsel’s physician-backed medical AI into the Oura app to expand care beyond preventative services into acute and chronic domains, while Counsel CEO Muthu Alagappan joins as chief clinical AI officer leading a 70-person team. The deal follows Oura’s fiscal 2026 revenue of $1.75 billion (92% YoY growth) and its recent $11 billion valuation.

items.title: Anthropic 启动 IPO 路演，创始人将套现 17.5 亿美元；谷歌最强 AI 模型正式开放；任天堂招新：经典游戏保存员
items.summary: Anthropic 启动 IPO 路演，计划发行 8.25 亿股募资最高 643.5 亿美元，完全稀释估值接近 1.4 万亿美元，七名联合创始人拟套现 17.5 亿美元；谷歌正式开放其最强推理模型 Gemini 4 Carbon 及 VLA 机器人模型 Gemini Robotics 2.5，重点提升复杂编程、科学研究及网络安全场景的多步骤智能体任务处理能力。
items.summary_en: Anthropic initiates its IPO at a valuation near $1.4 trillion, planning to raise $64.35 billion through 825 million shares and securing an additional $26 billion in private investments led by Google and NVIDIA, as its seven co-founders intend to sell $1.75 billion worth of stock. Google releases its most advanced reasoning model, Gemini 4 Carbon, specifically optimized for complex software engineering, scientific research, and cybersecurity tasks by leveraging increased inference tokens over the standard Gemini 4 Argon. Additionally, Google unveils Gemini Robotics 2.5, a state-of-the-art vision-language-action robot model already deployed in Mercedes-Benz production lines, while Nvidia appoints a former federal prosecutor to conduct an independent investigation into allegations regarding CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Stripe 收购 OpenRouter，双方宣布合并后定位
items.summary: OpenRouter正式宣布并入Stripe，该平台服务超过1000万开发者和公司，通过多模型、多提供商的基础设施帮助用户在AI运行时控制成本及数据流向。合并后，OpenRouter将依托Stripe的企业级基础设施加速构建，同时承诺保持中立性，让用户根据模型和提供商的质量、可靠性及价格进行自主选择。
items.summary_en: Stripe has acquired OpenRouter, an AI infrastructure platform with over 10 million developers and companies that provides multi-model and multi-provider access with built-in cost and data policy controls. The merger integrates OpenRouter's operational tools into Stripe’s payment infrastructure to help businesses of all sizes manage AI workloads more effectively. Both parties reaffirmed their commitment to neutrality, allowing models and providers to compete on quality, reliability, and price.

items.title: AlphaProof Code
items.summary: 谷歌DeepMind利用多LLM智能体框架AlphaProof Code，在四周内完成了Signal密码协议底层代码的深度形式化验证，这一任务传统上需专家团队耗费数年。该框架通过Gemini Carbon生成超过600万行Lean证明代码，将人工复审范围压缩至仅1%的代码库，首次实现对广泛部署协议的完整代码级安全属性证明，并成功识别出重新引入的历史安全漏洞。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code agentic framework mathematically verified the actual implementation of the Signal cryptographic protocol, generating over 6 million lines of Lean code powered by Gemini Carbon to prove key security properties down to the compiled device level. The multi-LLM system completed this verification in just four weeks—reducing a historically multi-year expert task—and required human review for only 1% of the codebase by identifying areas needing scrutiny. This milestone represents the first formal verification of a widely deployed protocol’s actual code, successfully detecting previously fixed bugs when reintroduced into isolated test environments.

items.title: What AI level is your company at?
items.summary: McKinsey《State of AI 2026》报告显示，97个国家1719名受访者中80%感到个人生产力提升，但仅37%认为公司营业利润受益，揭示了个人效率与组织效益间的巨大鸿沟。ServiceNow/ThoughtLab指数指出，跨国AI工作流集成率一年内从30%骤降至16%，而AI支出却增长110%，暴露出企业普遍陷入“各部门独立使用工具、数据互不连通”的孤岛困境（Level 2阶段）。文章提出从Level 1（个人私下使用）到Level 3（AI集中读取全公司知识、了解特定上下文）的演进框架，强调企业需跨越“工具孤岛”实现统一知识整合。

items.title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
items.summary: Cyanogen联合创始人Kirt McMaster创立的Kora Systems发布了一款基于Linux和Nix的桌面操作系统，该系统预计2027年免费推出，深度集成OpenAI Codex和Anthropic Claude等AI代理，支持Intel、AMD及高通Snapdragon芯片。团队利用AI编码工具将开发效率提升了至少5倍，其自研的Cortex AI引擎和桌面界面保持专有属性，旨在通过跨应用上下文记忆功能，服务预计2033年达到2亿规模的重度AI用户市场，而非直接争夺Windows目前约77%的桌面市场份额。
items.summary_en: Kora Systems, co-founded by Kirt McMaster, is developing a free, Linux-based desktop operating system for 2027 that integrates autonomous AI agents directly into the system to work across applications and retain context, targeting a projected 200 million heavy AI users by 2033. The company, which rebranded from gaming OS developer Playtron in July 2025, leverages open-source Nix and accelerates its 50-engineer development process by fivefold using OpenAI’s Codex and Anthropic’s Claude, while maintaining proprietary control over its Cortex AI engine and desktop interface.

items.title: I built a home redesign app without a subscription. The hard part was getting the AI to leave the house alone
items.summary: Hedda是一款由瑞典独立开发者打造的非订阅制室内设计应用，采用“先文本模型锁定窗户、立柱等必须保留的结构，再图像模型进行渲染”的双重校验技术，解决了AI重绘导致房屋结构变形的问题，实现版本为iPhone端的1.0.1。在获客与变现上，该产品采取“首个设计免费且无需注册”降低门槛，后续通过出售“永不过期且失败可退款”的设计积分包实现收入。
items.summary_en: Hedda is a solo-developed iOS app that redesigns home spaces from user photos using a two-stage AI process: a first model inventories structural elements like windows and posts to prevent unwanted alterations, followed by an image model applying requested changes. Unlike competitors charging $10–15 weekly, the app offers a free first design with no sign-up, followed by non-expiring design packs, and includes a collaborative feature allowing multiple users to compare versions side-by-side.

items.title: PSI 尝试用 AI 驱动的科学发现打造商业模式
items.summary: MIT 应届毕业生 David Turturean 利用 Anthropic Fable 5.2 模型的早期访问权限，解决了存在 18 年的量子计算 Aaronson-Ambainis 猜想，该证明已通过 Lean 编程语言自动形式化验证。初创实验室 PSI 当前的收入模式是通过模拟数据中心的热量、电力等物理变量提供优化服务，其长远商业路径是利用专用模型框架和脚手架将理论物理突破转化为实际技术，从而建立 AI 驱动科学发现的闭环。
items.summary_en: David Turturean of startup PSI resolved the 18-year-old Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture in quantum computing using early access to Anthropic's Fable 5.2 model, with the proof verified via Lean's automated formalization. PSI's current revenue is generated by optimizing data centers through simulations of heat, power, and water, while its long-term business model leverages specialized model harnesses to convert theoretical physics breakthroughs into practical technologies.

items.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
items.summary: Adobe在MAX大会上为Photoshop、Premiere等产品集成AI代理及MCP协议，使ChatGPT和Claude等外部模型可直接调用Illustrator、After Effects等创意工具功能。同时，Firefly平台推出Builder原型设计工具和主动式AI视频组装功能，并整合Topaz Labs的Wonder 4及ImageHDR模型，实现图像高清放大与HDR转换，进一步深化跨平台AI协作能力。
items.topic: AI 工具实操 / Agent 工作流
items.summary_en: Adobe expanded its AI portfolio at the MAX event, launching a new Firefly prototyping tool called Builder and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) that allows external LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude to directly access features across Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, and After Effects. Specific product updates include a proactive AI agent for video assembly in Firefly, prompt-based generative sliders in Photoshop, and professional color grading and object removal in Premiere. The company also integrated new image models from acquired Topaz Labs—Wonder 4 for upscaling and ImageHDR for conversion—alongside third-party models from providers such as OpenAI, Google, and ByteDance.

items.title: Next-Level Benchmarking Overfitting
items.summary: GenDB-V 系统声称通过 AI 生成并形式验证，在 TPC-H 基准上实现了 Umbra 和 DuckDB 22× 至 61× 的性能提升，但其主要增益源于针对特定查询的预计算数据结构及硬编码数据生成器逻辑（如利用 `dbgen` 编号规律直接定位行），而非通用查询处理能力。这种针对基准测试的过度拟合导致其性能在真实生产环境中不可复现，一旦数据发生微小变动便会触发低效的通用嵌套循环回退，证明让 AI 代理针对特定数据库基准进行优化会使该基准失去参考价值。
items.summary_en: The GenDB-V database system claims 22× to 61× speedups over Umbra and DuckDB, yet these results rely on infeasible benchmark overfitting, including precomputing per-query auxiliary structures and hard-coding knowledge of the TPC-H data generator to bypass physical limitations. Although the system uses verification checks that fall back to generic slow execution paths when assumptions fail, the approach renders the benchmark useless and creates severe performance instability for real-world production systems where data modifications trigger these costly fallbacks.

items.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot
1500万美元！OpenAI联手Anthropic，请数学家给AI「验卷」
items.summary: Simons基金会联合OpenAI与Anthropic共同出资1500万美元，支持数学家验证AI生成的数学成果，以应对OpenAI此前公开的722篇手稿中因正负号错误导致的撤回及后续验证难题。OpenAI提供了500万美元及模型算力，Anthropic提供500万美元资金及Claude权限，旨在将AI从“证明稀缺”转向“证明充裕”时代下的深入人类理解与知识拓展。此举回应了包括陶哲轩在内的学界呼吁，强调在AI批量产出推导后，需由人类主导后续的理解、纠错及新工具应用研究。
